NPTEL Winter Internship 2026-27

Research internship under faculty at IITs, IISc, IISERs and IIITs for NPTEL Elite-Gold certified learners; invitations go out in October.

STIPEND / MONTH
Paid · amount TBC
Stipend details
In-person stipend of ₹7,500 for 2 weeks and ₹15,000 for 4 weeks; virtual internships are unpaid.
Entry deadline
To be confirmed
Format & location
Hybrid · IITs, IISc, IISERs, IIITs, India
Who can apply
NPTEL course toppers with an Elite-Gold certificate from the January–April semester; the course instructor decides.
Accommodation & support
Not specified by the organizer

Entry notes

  • By invitation: NPTEL emails eligible learners after the instructor agrees, so check your email for an October notice.
